Jwt.Comment: Turned on per environment via Auth__Jwt__Enabled in cdp-app-config. Off by default so a build never needs deployment secrets.

Reset.Comment: Guards POST /v1/maintenance/reset, which permanently deletes data. Set Auth__Reset__Key as a Portal secret only where a wipe is acceptable; leaving it unset disables the endpoint.

Rules.Comment: Turned on per environment via Rules__Enabled in cdp-app-config. Off by default so a build or a test host never fires a run.

Krds.Comment: BaseUrl is the KRDS Data Bridge for the environment; ApiKey is the bare key, set as a Portal secret. The scheme is added by the client.
